name: Hass-MCP
description: Hass-MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that lets compatible AI clients query, control and troubleshoot Home Assistant through a stateless Streamable HTTP endpoint.

app_vars.name: var_ha_url
app_vars.label: Home Assistant URL
app_vars.help: Base URL reachable from the LXC, including scheme and port

app_vars.name: var_ha_token
app_vars.label: Home Assistant Token
app_vars.help: Long-lived access token for the Home Assistant account Hass-MCP will use

notes.text: Connect MCP clients to http://<LXC-IP>:8000/mcp. If var_mcp_port is changed, use that port instead.

Hass-MCP HTTP transport has no built-in client authentication and grants the Home Assistant permissions of the configured token. Keep the port on a trusted network or protect it with a VPN, zero-trust network or authenticated reverse proxy. Never expose it directly to the public internet.
Configuration is stored in /opt/hass-mcp_data/hass-mcp.env with mode 600. Dashboard backups are stored in /opt/hass-mcp_data/dashboard-backups.
